issue.title: [Bug]: [202405] lldp/test_lldp_syncd.py failing on 202405 branch due to mising hget_all() function

failure.body:
### Issue Description

Ran the newly added lldp/test_lldp_syncd.py (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/14658) and ran into `E       AttributeError: 'SonicDbCli' object has no attribute 'hget_all'`

The cause is that the `hget_all()` function from `tests/common/helpers/sonic_db.py` is present in the master branch but not merged to 202405 branch.  Looks like the PR that added this function to master (https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/13574) was approved for 202405 but is no longer due to merge conflict.  Can we get this resolved and merged to fix this issue?

### Results you see

lldp/test_lldp_syncd.py fails with `E       AttributeError: 'SonicDbCli' object has no attribute 'hget_all'`

### Results you expected to see

`hget_all` function should exist in 202405
